problemStatement.formal: For any Sperner coloring of a grid triangulation of the 2D simplex, there exists a fully-colored triangle.
problemStatement.plain: 2D Sperner's lemma: any valid coloring of a triangulated simplex must contain a rainbow triangle. Proved via row-sweep parity argument.
